title: BatchOps
description: INPUT of `dmtool batch <ops.json>` — a JSON array of independent verb invocations run in one process. Dispatch is stateless and non-transactional: every op is attempted, a failed child never rolls back an earlier write, and each result echoes its `id`/`verb`/`args` plus exact exit. The outer envelope has `outcome:completed` and `data.dispatched:true` after full dispatch; `data.allSucceeded`, outer `ok`, and the process exit report whether every child succeeded. Optional `--observations <file>` overwrites the compact deterministic static-kernel artifact described by this response's `observationArtifact` annotation; observation mode preflights every child and accepts only caller-tagged rule-check conditions or computation add/modify specs in --dry-run mode. Use `apply` instead for ordered, atomic edits to one model ({target,op,…}, one terminal gate + rollback — see `schema apply`).

verb.description: the verb to run (any except `batch`, which cannot nest)

args.description: the verb's argv (as on the command line, minus the verb)

id.description: optional caller tag, echoed back on the result for correlation; required and non-blank when --observations is used
